purpose: Roll out native Field Collector farm-activity lifecycle migrations 383–384 to the local Kernel candidate.

restore_rehearsal.target: kokonut_restore on a fresh template0 database in an internal-only recovery project

checkpoint.scope: Single PostgreSQL database only; excludes roles/grants, other databases, Docker volumes, external media, and provider state.

migration.command: python3 -m services.migration migrate --schemas-only --compose-project kokonut-kernel-candidate --compose-file docker-compose.kernel-candidate.yml --compose-file docker-compose.kernel-metabase.yml

application.oidc_configuration: disabled; no provider-backed login or review workflow was exercised

rollback.policy: Use the retained checkpoint for a pre-acceptance database restore; after native workflow data exists, preserve guards and prefer a reviewed forward migration.

limitations: No real OIDC provider is configured, so authorized browser workflow acceptance remains open.
The candidate contains no farm-activity or offline-collection rows; no live domain transition was exercised.
Higher-contention promotion stress, final report/metric handoff acceptance, and MAN-CAP-001 remain open.
